modules.name: My lil Looper
modules.description: Five-track stereo live looper: record, overdub with undo, reverse and one-shot per track, synced to the first loop or a clock

modules.name: My lil Looper CV
modules.description: Expander for My lil Looper: five poly CV lanes that record and play with the tracks, so a sung or played line loops as CV too

modules.name: My lil Looper FX
modules.description: Expander for My lil Looper: per-track DJ filter, half/double speed, mute, stutter and tape stop, and 8 scenes recalled on the bar
